content.title: Deutsche Bank sees S&P 500 running as high as 8,000 in 2026
content.description:
As stock futures (ES=F, NQ=F, YM=F) are in the green on November's last full day of trading, Wall Street forecasts are looking rather bullish on what's to come in 2026.

Yahoo Finance senior markets reporter Ines Ferré outlines the major firms' 2026 year-end targets for the S&P 500 (^GSPC), which includes Deutsche Bank's forecast of 8,000 and JPMorgan's expectations that the market could exceed its own predictions of 7,500.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
